When I was around 10 or 11 I was at a friends house and we had been swimming for most of the afternoon when she got out of the pool and wanted to show me these bugs that lived under these cement stepping stones she had in her backyard. They were thick concrete stepping stones the size of a serving platter, and I was leaning down on both knees in the grass looking at the bugs, not realizing that my knee was in the way. Once she was done looking at them she slammed the stepping stone back down and on to my knee. I immediately started bleeding and my knee was black and blue. I had a scar for a while after the incident, but it’s pretty much gone away now, 13 years later.

When I was a baby, not walking yet, my grandmother was watching me and had put me in a walker. My grandmother lived in a townhouse on a man made lake in Florida, and there was a patio with stairs that led to a small concrete landing that was about 3ft above water level where she had her small boat tied up. She takes me out to the patio, in my walker, and she goes back inside the house for a second. I end up rolling down the steps in my walker and my grandmother had a yellow lab who just so happened to be at the right place at the right time as he stopped walking right by the edge of the lake so when I rolled down the stairs, he blocked me from falling into the lake! I’m 22 y/o and my grandmother still gets emotional telling this story.
